worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.summary: Focuses willpower into the forehead to lock onto the target, then charges in and keeps steering into it. The dash turns toward the target every tick, but only up to a limit - a straight run cannot escape it, an abrupt turn or a loop can. Special Attack drives the tracking, Attack drives the impact.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.descriptio: The headbutt deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block collision radius; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
After locking on it drives up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; the psychic tether reaches %3$s blocks, so pulling farther away shakes off the guidance.
The dash turns at most %1$s degrees per tick toward the target and shoves it %2$s blocks on a hit.
A solid hit has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s; the lock ring stays on the target for %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.guided.on: Guided form: the willpower grips tighter and drives farther, but starts slower with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.guided.off: Direct form: faster to cast with a shorter cooldown, but it cannot turn well and may fail to catch a straight run.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.growth.0: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s and the turn rate to %3$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.growth.1: From level %1$s the headbutt power rises to %2$s, the lock range to %3$s blocks, the drive to %4$s blocks and the turn rate to %5$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.use.0: Lock on at medium range and chase a moving target down
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.use.1: Force a target to make an abrupt turn to shake the guidance
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.use.2: Follow up a partner's opening control with a ranged contact
worldcombat.skill.zenheadbutt.preference: On: the willpower grips tighter and drives farther, but starts slower with a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: a close direct charge - faster to cast with a shorter cooldown, but it cannot turn well and may fail to catch a straight run.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger lets it open from farther, and is more likely to lose the target after locking.
Fresh only: skip a target another move already flinched, saving this for one that can still be staggered. Always: treat it as an ordinary attack.
